value.body: An academic counsellor talks with students and parents about courses, fees and admissions for an ed-tech company, coaching institute, school or college. In most private organisations the role is closer to sales: counsellors work through enquiry leads and are measured on enrolments.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: Good spoken communication in English and a regional language

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Phone, CRM software, email and messaging

items.label: Students in higher education
items.note: All levels from certificate to Ph.D.; growth was under 1% over 2022-23

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers are hired directly by ed-tech firms, coaching institutes and colleges after a communication-focused interview; some roles include a short sales training period.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many roles carry monthly enrolment targets and incentive-linked pay.
It differs from a psychology-based counsellor, which needs professional training.
Growth leads to team lead, admissions manager or student success roles.

value.title: Students enrolled in higher education
value.note: Colleges and universities only; coaching institutes, ed-tech courses and school admissions are not counted.
